name: Alexander
style: A quick-footed Rider with a kopis: four fast chops, a guard-breaking heavy, and Bucephalus' charge to close the gap or run a runner down.

moves.name: Kopis Chops
moves.notes: Four quick chops, each a little heavier. The third lifts the opponent; the fourth is a flaming cut that sends them flying back. Each chop can be chained into the next as soon as it hits.

moves.name: Rising Cut
moves.notes: A rising swing a little slower than the first chop. It pops the opponent up to float, with no knockdown. Jump after them to keep the combo going.

moves.name: Sky Cuts
moves.notes: Three air swings. The first two pop the opponent up a little and keep them floating close, and carry you along with them; the third knocks them down. Damage is per swing, before combo scaling.

moves.name: Kopis Plunge
moves.notes: Drops straight down with the blade. If it connects you bounce back up. Down + LIGHT in the air plunges too.

moves.name: Heavy Cut
moves.notes: A bigger, slower version of the last chop: slower to start, but it breaks guards, so a guard does not stop it. With the stick toward a grounded opponent in reach, HEAVY becomes the throw instead.

moves.name: Crusher Throw
moves.notes: Grabs a grounded opponent in front of you and in reach, and a guard does not stop it. The victim can break free by pressing LIGHT or HEAVY in the first 8 ticks of the grab.

moves.name: Bucephalus Charge
moves.notes: Bucephalus, his great black warhorse, charges in a short, fast run. It hits once with big knockback that pops the opponent up. The charge keeps its speed and cannot be steered once it starts. Cooldown 7 seconds.

moves.name: Stampede
moves.notes: Rift Art, ready at a full Rift gauge. Bucephalus, wreathed in flame, thunders across the arena in one pierce that ignores guards and sets the opponent alight; the flames burn for about 2.5 seconds.

moves.name: Cavalry Dash
moves.notes: A burst of the Companions' charge along the ground. Invulnerable for its first 8 ticks (about 0.13 seconds). On the ground it has a cooldown; in the air it uses one of your two air-dash charges.

combos.name: Rising Kopis
combos.notes: The rising cut pops them up to float. Jump after them and finish with the sky cuts; the last one knocks them down.

combos.name: Chop and drop
combos.notes: The third chop lifts the opponent. Jump after them and drop the plunge onto them; if it connects, you bounce back up.

combos.name: Breaker
combos.notes: Two chops, then the heavy, chained on the hit. The heavy breaks guards, so use it against a guarding opponent. If the stick points at them in reach, the heavy becomes the throw.
